/**
 * The cockpit object, typed for the IDE.
 * artifacts/cockpit-lib/cockpit.js builds the object at runtime, so the IDE can't see its
 * members. The JSDoc cast points it at artifacts/cockpit-lib/cockpit.d.ts instead.
 * Import this module instead of 'cockpit' in app code.
 *
 * @file cockpitTyped.js
 * @license AGPL-3.0-or-later
 * @author Vellamo.fyi
 */

 * Countdown rule of the header auto refresh: how long it stays on after a (re)start (4 minutes, or

/**
 * File rules of the drop-quadlet tab, the same as PodShift's quadlet-drop action checks:
 * a plain, not hidden name, a Quadlet type of PODSHIFT_DROP_QUADLET_EXTENSIONS or a .zip
 * bundle, a base name that passes is-valid-app-name, and 1 byte to 50 KB
 * (PODSHIFT_DROP_MAX_BUNDLE_SIZE). Also the base64 encoding of the upload.
 *
 * @file DropFileRules.js
 * @license AGPL-3.0-or-later
 * @author Vellamo.fyi
 */
/**
 * Status helpers of the drop history: the icon kind of each PodShift status, whether the
 * history still has an item in progress, the poll schedules of the tab and a drop made
 * elsewhere, the quadlet-remove name

 * success notice can hide.
 *
 * @file DropStatus.js
 * @license AGPL-3.0-or-later
 * @author Vellamo.fyi

/**
 * Decides whether a card can be uninstalled and what the Uninstall item removes: one installed
 * Quadlet file, or the whole app (bundle) it belongs to. The Quadlets tab gives the file name
 * and app of a Quadlet; the Containers, Volumes and Networks tabs give the quadlet field that
 * PodShift adds to an item made by an installed Quadlet file. Pure, so it has unit tests.
 *
 * @file QuadletUninstall.js
 * @license AGPL-3.0-or-later
 * @author Vellamo.fyi
 */
/**
 * Remembers the Uninstall targets queued a short while ago, so their Uninstall item stays
 * disabled and the same removal cannot be queued twice while PodShift still runs it. The tab
 * loads its list right after the queue and then polls it (UninstallRefresh), but stopping a unit
 * can take 10 seconds or more, so the item can still show for a while. The memory is shared by
 * all tabs, as each tab is unmounted while another one is open, and lasts until the page reloads.
 *
 * @file UninstallGuard.js
 * @license AGPL-3.0-or-later
 * @author Vellamo.fyi
 */
/**
 * Poll schedule of a tab with Uninstall while its auto refresh is on: fast for 2 minutes after
 * an Uninstall was queued, otherwise a slow delay for auto refresh turned on by hand.
 *
 * @file UninstallRefresh.js
 * @license AGPL-3.0-or-later
 * @author Vellamo.fyi
 */

/**
 * Downloads through a cockpit-ws external channel, the way Cockpit's own pages do it
 * (cockpit-files download.tsx): a same-origin GET on /cockpit/channel/<csrf token>?<open options>.
 * cockpit-ws opens the channel on the bridge and sends its data as the response body, with the
 * Content-Disposition and Content-Type headers given in the "external" option. No blob: or data:
 * URL is involved, so the page's default Content Security Policy ('self') allows it.
 *
 * @file ChannelDownload.js
 * @license AGPL-3.0-or-later
 * @author Vellamo.fyi
 */

/**
 * Base class for modules that show a filterable card grid (Containers, Images,
 * Volumes, Networks, Secrets, Services, Quadlets). Subclasses set their settings, including
 * the toolbar filter or filters, in the constructor, override card() and countText(), and
 * override any static helper they need to change. A module with other views
 * overrides dialogs() and closeAndRefresh(). Hooks stay in the page; this class
 * only builds the UI from ModulePageState. Items made by an installed Quadlet file get an
 * Uninstall item, which opens the shared Uninstall modal.
 *
 * @file BaseModule.jsx
 * @license AGPL-3.0-or-later
 * @author Vellamo.fyi
 */

/**
 * Services module: settings, state filter, row helpers, the service resource card and
 * the unit, status and log dialogs. The systemd user services of the podshift user are
 * listed like `systemctl --user list-units --type=service --all`, without units that are
 * not found. The data comes from the services-list action; the views from quadlet-view,
 * service-view and service-logs.
 *
 * @file ServicesModule.jsx

 * @author Vellamo.fyi

/**
 * The main page: the tab sub-nav with an auto refresh toggle and a refresh button, then the
